generation: greedy, FP32 computation of stored BF16 base values, TF32 disabled, SDPA, native EOS151643, batch8
target_encoding: fixed prompt IDs followed by separately tokenized compact JSON and native EOS; prompt labels masked
toolace_scope: positive first-turn calls only, all leaf argument values literally supported by user request; excludes no-call and inferred arguments; preserved API-disjoint partitions; not BFCL
toolace_metric: whole-call multiset exact match, documented top-level defaults normalized, numerical int/float equivalence only for number schemas; exact string values
cluener_metric: generate type/text/occurrence; align mechanically to source text without gold; original typed-span micro F1 primary; typed-text micro F1 and strict JSON separately
checkpoint_selection: no selection in pilot; retain 16-step and final results
limitations: single training seed; pilot subset; no causal attribution of pretraining contamination; no architecture-effect conclusion from Stage A
